name: Dimension-Filtered Positive Ample Classes
summary: Ample classes with a full signed allocation whose coefficients on supports of size at most k are nonnegative.
parameters: Integer k >= 0. Fixed levels zero, one and two equal Amp; Pos_3 has its own entry.
comments: All cube equations remain imposed. The inherited Pos_2 = Amp theorem has author-proof status; no higher-order equality or fixed-level conditioning closure is asserted.
